steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal application to PMI with proof of education and experience hours. Pay the associated PMI examination fee. PMI reviews applications to confirm eligibility. Processing typically takes weeks; plan accordingly as you finalize your exam date.

steps_items.text: After passing, you'll earn the PMP® mark—a valued credential in Tacoma's project-intensive sectors. Renew every three years by earning professional development units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, and continuing education. Stay current with PMI standards and keep your credential active throughout your career.
